posts.author: Vladar458
posts.body:
It is said that a mysterious place has appeared on the outskirts of a peaceful town. It is a theater found in a mountainous area, seemingly abandoned, but someone has taken it back. Posters around town claim that "Edevreal" took it over and runs the place.Hearing these rumors, a group of four friends: Ayla, Michael, Maggy, and Leavi, go to visit the place, only to realize that the owner doesn't seem human, and that paranormal events occur there, including the strange Rybis.
Now the four friends will be forced to separate and enter Edevreal's devious game, a deadly game where they will risk their lives.
Edevreal's Theater: The Final Show is a horror RPG with real-time combat created in RPG Maker MV by Vladar Drarkus. It features:
An interesting story split between the four protagonist and several mysterious characters, specially Edevreal.
Explore haunting locations filled with secrets and hidden clues. The mansion is a huge place, it has a lot to hide.
Inspired by RPG Maker horror games, and Resident Evil.
A creepy and curious atmosphere.
A battle system in real time with a moderate challenge.
Replayability value with several endings.
